entries.title: I don't want to work very hard
entries.author: flaneur
entries.current_title: I don't want to work very hard
entries.excerpt: I've been a professional developer about ten years now and I don't want to do it any more. I don't mean developing, I love coding. I mean work. At every workplace (big to small, profit and non-, startup to hegemony), I'm enthusiastic the first couple weeks but inevitably slide to keeping up appearances with 2-6 hours of actual work per week. Sometimes I like coworkers and projects, sometimes I haven't. In any case, after a year or so I'm completely frustrated and I leave, to
entries.guide_zh: 一位热爱写代码的资深开发者坦言难以维持职场工作动力。

entries.title: Ask YC: Let's start a Hacker News book club
entries.author: robertk
entries.current_title: Ask YC: Let's start a Hacker News book club
entries.excerpt: This is in response to http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=406995 How about each week or month (I know we're all busy, so perhaps monthly is better), we all agree on a book to read and discuss? I am very busy for many parts of the year, and often don't have time to read leisurely even though I would very much like to. I imagine the idea of an HN book club would help in this regard, as I would be much more motivated to make time (like a co-founder motivates you to keep going!)
entries.guide_zh: 提议成立 HN 读书会，以定期共读推动阅读和交流。

entries.title: Ask HN: How do big web sites roll out new versions?
entries.author: Bluem00
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do big web sites roll out new versions?
entries.excerpt: The operations of big websites fascinate me. Sites such as http://highscalability.com/ give an glimpse into the architecture of Amazon, Twitter, and other large systems, but leave out the operations side. So, can anyone explain how they deploy new versions of their sites? For instance, I can't imagine Amazon choosing to go down for even a minute, so what do they do? Am I wrong? Thanks!
entries.guide_zh: 大型网站如何部署新版本，又怎样避免升级造成服务中断？

entries.title: Ask YC: Review my startup, Userfly
entries.author: cte
entries.current_title: Ask YC: Review my startup, Userfly
entries.excerpt: Check it out at http://userfly.com/ In short, Userfly captures actual browsing sessions from real users as if you were looking over their shoulder. What we've found is that watching real users actually use your site can be remarkably insightful, so we built Userfly to accomplish that goal. There's a screencast that will walk you through the basic functionality. Click on the demo button above it to mess around without having to sign up for an account. Would love your feedback
entries.guide_zh: Userfly 记录真实用户浏览过程，作者邀请评测这款行为观察工具。
